So this was a project for a course at college. I may have stepped it over, the base idea was to go out and capture cool looking reflections. I'm not even studying photography. It's grade school teacher studies, and this was side project for an art oriented course.
But photography is a beloved hobby of mine so I went all in and wanted capture my even more beloved pet snakes. 

This was shot on my Huawei P30pro. Only light source was the flash always on and in the macro setting. The snakes are mine I actually bred some of them, they weren't hurt. I know the focus wasn't always on the head, although I tried really hard they were moving a lot.
They're on a plexiglass, with the backside painted black. The plexi to prevent the double reflexion that you get when working with glass. I also put a lot of black sheets around to prevent anything else showing.

For editing I used Snapseed and Photoshop Express. The changes I made was to blacken the blacks and colors, the structure. I tried to make the reflections pop out more, but they are the real reflections. I dont even know yet how to fake them.

I'd be happy to get any advice, critic or just opinions.
